info.name: Docusign Gets the definition of a template.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of records to return.

params.name: folder
params.description: The query value can be a folder name or folder ID. The response will only return templates in the specified folder.

params.name: folder_ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of folder ID GUIDs.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Start of the search date range. Only returns templates created on or after this date/time. If no value is specified, there is no limit on the earliest date created.

params.name: include
params.description:
A comma-separated list of additional information to include in the response. Valid values are: 

- `recipients`: Includes information about template recipients.
- `folders`: Includes information about the folder that holds the template. 
- `documents` : Includes information about template documents.
- `custom_fields`: Includes information about template custom fields.
- `notifications`: Includes information about the notification settings for templates.
- `advanced_templates`: Includes advanced templates in the response. For example, these include templates that use advanced recipient routing. We recommend that you use this option to ensure that the response includes all relevant templates.

params.name: order
params.description:
Sets the direction order used to sort the list. Valid values are: 

- `asc` = ascending sort order (a to z)  
- `desc` = descending sort order (z to a)

params.name: order_by
params.description:
Sets the file attribute used to sort the list. Valid values are:  

- `name`: template name  
- `modified`: The date and time the template was last modified.  
- `used`: The date and time the template was last used.

params.name: search_text
params.description: The search text used to search the names of templates.

params.name: shared_by_me
params.description: If true, the response only includes templates shared by the user. If false, the response only returns template not shared by the user. If not specified, the response is not affected.

params.name: start_position
params.description: The starting index for the first template shown in the response. This must be greater than or equal to 0 (zero).

params.name: to_date
params.description: End of the search date range. Only returns templates created up to this date/time. If no value is provided, this defaults to the current date.

params.name: used_from_date
params.description: Start of the search date range. Only returns templates used or edited on or after this date/time. If no value is specified, there is no limit on the earliest date used.

params.name: used_to_date
params.description: End of the search date range. Only returns templates used or edited up to this date/time. If no value is provided, this defaults to the current date.

params.name: user_filter
params.description: Sets if the templates shown in the response Valid values are:  -owned_by_me: only shows templates the user owns.  -shared_with_me: only shows templates that are shared with the user.  -all: shows all templates owned or shared with the user.

params.name: user_id
params.description: The id of the user.
